$comment: Resolution map for `arch check` ONLY — nothing compiles against this. It exists so dependency-cruiser can follow web-v2's `@/*` alias; without it 841 of the repo's import edges are unresolvable, and an unresolvable edge is DROPPED, so every contract over that package passes on an empty graph. Declared by `.arch.json` -> tsConfig. It sits at the repo root because tsc resolves `include` against the tsconfig's own directory, so a copy under .forge/ finds no inputs. Keep `paths` in sync with packages/web-v2/tsconfig.json.
